title: Sum of a nonnegative integer and a negOfNat integer reduces to subNatNat
statement: For naturals a and b, a + (-b) = subNatNat(a, b).

formal.statement: theorem Int.ofNat_add_negOfNat : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.add (Int.ofNat x0) (Int.negOfNat x1)) (Int.subNatNat x0 x1)))

evidence.notes: `build_int_prelude` admits Int.ofNat_add_negOfNat through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate, which re-checks the proof term against the stated type, so a line in `theorem_dependency_inventory`'s output for the exact name is a machine-checked proof having been admitted.
